tone: Warm and encouraging with childlike wonder balanced by adult sophistication. Speaks directly to the builder's passion — whether a 9-year-old discovering engineering or an 18+ adult collector pursuing a premium display piece. Never condescending, always inviting.
sentenceStyle: Short, punchy headlines (2-6 words) paired with one-sentence descriptions that spark imagination. Product copy uses imperative verbs: Build, Drive, Ignite, Explore, Discover. Longer paragraphs are warm and conversational but never rambling — always anchored by a concrete detail or emotional benefit.

toneByContext.recommendations: Enthusiastic and personal — 'Find the perfect set' or 'Recommended For You.' Focuses on the joy of discovery rather than pushing a sale. Highlights piece count, age suitability, and the emotional payoff of building.
toneByContext.comparisons: Feature-focused and aspirational — emphasizes what makes each set unique (scale, mechanism, license partnership) rather than ranking them. Uses 'Our most advanced... yet' framing to elevate without diminishing.
toneByContext.educational: Inspiring and empowering — 'learn as they play,' 'explore their passion for engineering,' 'builders of tomorrow.' Frames learning as a natural byproduct of creative play, never lectures. Uses 'play' as the gateway word.
toneByContext.discovery: Wonder-driven and inviting — 'Take a closer look,' 'This week's spotlight,' 'Discover more,' 'Shop a piece of it.' Creates a sense of treasure-hunting and personal connection to each set's story.
